name: Bases Multi-Row Edit
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds a Bases table with row selection, property preview, conflict-aware bulk edits and undo.
Adds optional saved actions and session undo history through GitHub Sponsors.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now have a More from NoteMods group, with a switch that turns this tab off.
tip: Run Undo the last bulk edit from the command palette to undo a batch, or give it a hotkey.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Multi-Row Edit is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases.
